seo.title: Skills Assurance: Digital CV, Skills Assessment & Training | YFP Assurance
seo.description: Video-based Digital CVs, employer practical skills assessments and practical training with documented completion records, for hospitality, construction, events and technical services.

hero.title: Don’t Just Claim Competence. Demonstrate It.
hero.lead: Video-based portfolios, practical assessments and documented learning, so professionals can show what they can do and employers can see it for themselves.

digital_cv.label: A · For professionals
digital_cv.title: Digital CV
digital_cv.text: A professional digital portfolio featuring your work history, completed projects and video evidence of your practical skills, so people can see what you can do instead of only reading about it.
points: A clear, professional presentation you control
digital_cv.notice: The Digital CV is an optional, standalone portfolio product. It is not a fee for recruitment, job applications, placement or access to employers.

assessment.label: B · For employers
assessment.title: Employer Skills Assessment
assessment.tagline: See What Candidates Can Actually Do.
assessment.text: Request practical, video-based assessments and receive structured skills reports based on clearly defined job criteria. Candidates are never charged for employer assessments.
points: You define the role and the criteria that matter
You receive a structured report against your criteria

training.label: C · For teams and individuals
training.title: Training & Practical Learning
training.tagline: Learn It. Demonstrate It. Prove It.
training.text: Practical learning libraries, video training, structured assessments and documented completion records, so learning ends in something you can show.
points: Practical learning libraries and video training

disclaimer.title: Important.
disclaimer.text: Skills Assurance documents and reports what an individual demonstrates against stated criteria. It is not an official certification or a licence, it does not guarantee competence, and it does not include employment placement. YFP Assurance does not operate a job board or recruitment service.

form.title: Tell us what you need
form.intro: Register interest in a Digital CV, request candidate assessments or ask about training.

sidebar.employers_text: Share the role and how many candidates you want assessed. We will confirm the criteria and the assessment format before you commit.
sidebar.professionals_text: Register your interest in a Digital CV. We will let you know when orders open.
